3566.title: Desktop packaging omits npm runtime dependencies
3566.rootCauseOneLine: The pnpm dependency collector omits npm bundled dependencies while the file copier excludes nested node_modules, leaving proc-log unavailable.
3566.proposedFix: Preserve bundled npm dependencies in desktop packaging and smoke-test the packaged CLI.
3566.caveats: Actual packaging file selection reproduced twice; signed app and Extensions UI were not exercised. Packaging changes are excluded from simple fixes.
